original_ai_output.title_zh: 评论：选举无法创造和平，和平才能让选举奏效
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 一篇评论文章质疑南苏丹SPLM-IG坚持选举是结束叛乱与暴力唯一途径的立场，认为在和平协议未落实、政治空间收缩、机构缺乏独立性的情况下仓促选举可能引发冲突。文章援引安哥拉、科特迪瓦、肯尼亚、乌干达等国选举引发暴力的历史教训，并提及联合国南苏丹人权委员会报告称2025年8月至2026年1月间发生407起停火违规。

key_facts.fact: 评论文章质疑SPLM-IG关于选举是结束叛乱唯一途径的主张
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: I sometimes wonder what is ringing in the minds of some educated members and supporters of the SPLM-IG when they insist that elections are the only road to ending rebellion and violence in South Sudan

key_facts.fact: 联合国南苏丹人权委员会报告称2025年8月至2026年1月间发生407起停火违规
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The UN Commission on Human Rights in South Sudan reported 407 ceasefire violations between August 2025 and January 2026

key_facts.fact: 联合国机构警告在缺乏保障的情况下仓促选举可能加深冲突并增加暴行犯罪风险
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: warned in August 2026 that rushing towards elections without essential safeguards could deepen conflict and increase the risk of atrocity crimes

key_facts.fact: 文章援引安哥拉、科特迪瓦、肯尼亚、乌干达等国选举引发暴力的历史案例
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: In Angola, a disputed 1992 election shattered the Bicesse peace process and returned the country to devastating war. Côte d'Ivoire's 2010 disputed presidential election produced a deadly confrontation.

uncertainties: 文章为评论观点，非事实性新闻报道
联合国报告的407起停火违规数据来自文章转述，未提供原始报告链接
